chapter: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

quests.title: Tepetlisaurus Hide-and-Seek

dialogue.t: Whoa, where is this mysterious place? So many little Tepetlisaurs...
Could it be some sort of... Tepetlisaurus gathering spot?
Rawr! ...Rrrawr?
{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} looks so excited! Not often that you get to meet so many companions all in one go, huh?
Rawr?
Oh, you mean you wanna go over there and play with them? Come to think of it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} hardly ever gets to hang out with other little Tepetlisaurs...
Rawr!
Uhh, Paimon's still a bit worried... Anyway, let's find somewhere to relax and have something to eat while we wait for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogue.sit: You and Paimon find a nice spot nearby to rest until {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is done playing.
But you end up waiting longer than you expected...

dialogue.t: Strange... How come {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} isn't back yet?
Paimon sure hopes nothing bad's happened...

dialogue.sit: Gotten a bit carried away with the fun and games, perhaps?

dialogue.t: If so, we'll have to give him a good talking-to. The sun's nearly set!
Ugh... Let's go track it down before it gets so dark we can't even see.
Hi! You haven't seen {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} around here, have you? Y'know, the new kid on the block...?
It's got a mark on its head and a scarf on its tail...
Rrrawr?
Hmm, seems like it can't understand what we're saying.
Looks like we have no other choice but to go through them one by one...
Grainfruit, yummy...
*burp*
Take a look at this little Tepetlisaurus... This one sure knows how to choose a spot for itself!
No, that can't be {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} either. There's no tail-scarf.
Rrrawr?
From stand here, all other Saurians small as bug...
Hey, is there any chance you've seen...

dialogue.sit: Paimon tells the clever little Tepetlisaur what {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} looks like.

dialogue.t: Rawr!
Rawr!!
Wait a minute, does that mean you know we're looking for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? You really are a clever little critter, huh?
C'mon, let's catch up!
Let's eat, friend!
Berry, Cacahuatl, Grainfruit!
Wow, so many Berries... Thanks! Wait a sec, we're looking for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, not Berries!
Rrrawr?

dialogue.sit: We're not the type to say no to Berries!

dialogue.t: Rawr!
Well, being given Berries is never a bad thing, but it seems like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} isn't here. Let's keep looking!

dialogue.section: Little Tepetlisaurus Learning How to Dig

dialogue.t: Oh no, been caught... Must... Dig faster!

dialogue.section: Little Tepetlisaurus Learning How to Dig

dialogue.t: Alright, looks like we've got ourselves a little Tepetlisaurus digging about underground. This has to be—
Ugh, that's not {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} either...
*sigh* How are there so many little Tepetlisaurs here? Where in Teyvat did {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} go?
Hello there, how do you do...
Uhh, wait a sec... Why has Paimon suddenly started greeting little Tepetlisaurs like this?
Rawr! Rawr!
Hehe, thanks...
But back to the matter at hand, this little Tepetlisaur clearly isn't {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...
Well, let's just hope that {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s been having as much fun as this little one.
Happy happy~ Me so happy~
Aha! So you've been here snoozing away! No wonder we couldn't find you all this time...
Wrroh...
Looks like you had so much fun you completely tired yourself out.
But the world's a dangerous place, y'know! If you start feeling sleepy or need a rest, you've got to come find us first...

dialogue.sit: I told you to be careful...
I said not to be gone too long...

dialogue.t: Rowr...
Alright, alright... Nothing wrong with a bit of fun every now and again. But be more careful in the future, okay?
Anyway, why don't we go say hi to that big Tepetlisaurus over there? Who knows, we might get another chance to hang out with this lot someplace else in the future!
Rawr!
Roarrr?
Thanks for taking care of {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} all this time!
Roarrr...
Rawr!
Uhh, well... Whatever they just said, it went right over Paimon's head.
Anyway, it's about time we were off. Say goodbye, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!
Rawr...

dialogue.sit: Don't be sad, we'll see them again!

dialogue.t: Rowrr... Rawr!
Roooar...
Raaarrr—
Rawr!
Rawr, rrawr...
Rrroar...

dialogue.sit:
The big Tepetlisaurus turns round, as if to signal that it was time that they were off...
The little Tepetlisaurs follow its lead, and together, they leave.

dialogue.t: Rawr...
Aww, you're not feeling lonely are you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?
Hehe, don't forget that we're here by your side!
Rowrr, rawr!
Hehe, so much energy... Very good...
But... how many were there in total again...?

quests.description: After running into a whole bunch of Tepetlisaurs while you’re out on the road, you let your Saurian companion go off to play with them. But then it doesn’t come back…

speakers: Little Tepetlisaurus Learning How to Dig
